comparison.objective: Form a two-bend 45-degree offset in tubing and place it on a template.
comparison.physical_skill: Repositioning tube through a hand bender, making opposite irreversible bends, and compensating for springback.
comparison.success_condition: Two acceptable bends, parallel ends at the specified offset, released on the template and still; over-bending or same-direction bends fail.
comparison.reason: Tests material forming and springback across two bends, not adjustment of an existing mechanism followed by jam-nut locking and functional cycles.
